errors.what: “Estradiol and inhibin feed back (negative)” appears beside the pathway without a line or arrow returning to either the hypothalamus or anterior pituitary.
errors.why_wrong: The figure does not show the feedback loop named in its caption or identify its targets.

errors.what: The connections between “Hypothalamus,” “Anterior pituitary,” and “Ovary” have no arrowheads.

errors.what: “Estradiol and inhibin feed back (negative)” groups the two hormones into one undirected statement.
errors.why_wrong: Inhibin chiefly suppresses pituitary FSH, while estradiol acts at the hypothalamus and pituitary and can produce positive feedback before ovulation.

verdict: The labels are readable and the organ sequence is correct, but the figure omits the feedback pathway that the caption promises to explain.
